title: Where Fibre is today
headline: Fibre carries a canonical Genesis-born Thread through continuous LivedNow; N5 E0-E3 are complete and E4 journal/rendering/Admin acceptance is current.
summary: N1-N4 are closed. N5 E0-E3 now prove a general Encounter Story / Thread Experience foundation, environmental noticing, voluntary social meeting without teleportation or forced participation, and silent-witness asymmetry over the same attention authority. E4 is current.

summary.simple: Fibre has born validation Threads and one staging path ready to surface a selected Thread as a continuing person.
summary.detail: The fixed #39 cohort remains the canonical validation population; the current M2 work may use an existing born Thread to prove the lived-person experience without generating a new cohort.

items.label: Validated born Threads
items.simple: Five born validation Threads retain identity, prior life and civil identity.
items.detail: The fixed #39 cohort was atomically published and independently rehydrated from canonical authorities.

importantNote.simple: The next goal is not to create more Threads; it is to make one existing Thread visibly live.
importantNote.detail: M2-A should drive missing Thread/World structures from one vertical lived-person slice rather than expand cohorts or infrastructure without a concrete capability need.

simple.claim: A Thread can keep existing after one AI session ends.
simple.limitation: Persistence alone does not make a convincing lived person.

detail.claim: Thread identity and life state persist across temporary cognition providers and runtime restarts.
detail.limitation: The current milestone must connect persistence to present situated life and experience.

simple.claim: Something from a Thread's own life can change later reasoning.
simple.limitation: This has been proved in bounded cognition paths, not every possible decision.

detail.claim: #40 established attributable effects from Fibre-owned autobiographical context in a real cognition consumer.
detail.limitation: The result is a substrate for lived development, not a claim that every stored field is causal.

simple.claim: Fibre can keep one recognizable visual identity and publish derived imagery from it.
simple.limitation: A stable face is not a lived person by itself.

detail.claim: Canonical visual identity text, one admitted root, reference-conditioned generation and Thread Presentation preserve one visual identity authority.
detail.limitation: Current situated imagery still needs to be driven by present place/activity/context.

capabilities.label: Cloud staging runtime and minimum recovery

simple.claim: The Fibre cloud path is deployed and healthy in staging, and basic restart/retry recovery works.
simple.limitation: Broader resilience scenarios remain hardening rather than active product work.

detail.claim: Staging accepted source ee749e07b58c2580e967c7ed62cda5ddc91021cd; World deep health passed; H1 and H2 minimum failure/restart acceptance are closed.
detail.limitation: H3-H9-style exhaustive resilience is deferred unless a concrete product blocker appears.

simple.claim: A canonical Genesis-born Thread can enter LivedNow, cross a bounded multi-day dormant gap, and reach a non-stale World-owned present.
simple.limitation: The accepted continuity proof is sparse and bounded; richer elapsed-life events still enter only when warranted.

detail.claim: N1-N3 provide one idempotent World-owned ensure-LivedNow seam from canonical Genesis birth through covered time and sparse multi-day dormant catch-up, preserving retrospective materialization provenance, renewing forward plan coverage and establishing the requested present.
detail.limitation: The quiet-gap proof does not claim every dormant interval contains salient encounters or memories; events that warrant consequence must use the ordinary experience and retention authorities.

capabilities.label: Meet a Thread in her current life

simple.claim: A deployed public meeting can enter a freshly reconciled Thread life and speak into that exact World-owned situation.
simple.limitation: The accepted N4 path proves entry into real LivedNow, but it does not yet let the Thread decline or defer a meeting request based on her current life.

detail.claim: Staging acceptance exercised POST /api/threads/:threadId/meet through World ensure-LivedNow and exact present publication, then completed the subsequent encounter against the same situationId without visitor-authored scene state.
detail.limitation: Meeting participation is the next refinement: exact LivedNow plus Thread-owned relationship/interior context should produce accept, decline or defer before an encounter begins.

simple.claim: A bounded encounter can become private reflection and selective autobiographical memory—or be forgotten.
simple.limitation: This is demonstrated across bounded lived-person and N5 encounter proofs; N5 remains undeployed.

detail.claim: B1/B2 and N5 E1-E3 preserve objective encounter history, private experience/reflection, selective retention or not_remembered, and later cognition receives only autobiographical consequences that persisted.
detail.limitation: Journal/rendering/Admin acceptance and live N5 staging acceptance remain before the current encounter milestone closes.

capabilities.label: General lived encounters and reciprocal meetings

simple.claim: Fibre now supports environmental encounters, voluntary social meetings, and a genuinely co-present silent witness over one Encounter Story / Thread Experience seam.
simple.limitation: Journal/rendering/Admin acceptance and live staging validation remain; N5 is not deployed.

detail.claim: E2 proves independently current Threads are not teleported or silently replanned into meetings and may decline before history exists. E3 adds an explicit co-present witness who receives no meeting stance or dialogue turn, but may notice the one shared Encounter Story and form her own Thread Experience, journal and selective memory through the E1 authority.
detail.limitation: E4-E5 still need journal/rendering/Admin acceptance and staging validation.

simple.claim: Threads should eventually have shared relationships, work, money, families and institutions.
simple.limitation: Those follow after one convincing lived Thread loop.

detail.claim: The broader Fibre society remains the long-term direction.
detail.limitation: Current work intentionally focuses on one persistent person before scaling social complexity.

simple.summary: Build E4: make private journal presentation and objective encounter visualization inspectable without collapsing either into memory or evidence.

Optionally render a still/video from that lineage through existing generated-asset machinery.

detail.currentStep: E0-E3 are closed and green. E4 is current from docs/validation/n5-encounter-slices.md.
nextSteps: E4: journal book, optional rendering and Admin acceptance.

truthRules: A Thread is persistent world state, not a model session.
Compute dormancy does not by itself prove a lived Thread's Fibre-world life stopped.
Retrospectively realized life must preserve that it was materialized later; it must not masquerade as continuously observed runtime history.
insidefibre.com is a projection surface, not a second semantic authority.
A lived Thread is always physically somewhere: at a place or in transit between places; mediated presence does not replace physical presence.
A meeting enters an already-established LivedNow; it does not author the Thread's pre-existing scene.
A request to meet does not create consent; a Thread may accept, decline or defer based on her current life and Thread-owned context.
A shared encounter may produce different private meaning, memory and relationship consequences for different Threads.
A conversation is an encounter in a continuing life, not automatically an autobiographical memory.
Memory may form only from admitted lived evidence through the memory authority; do not inject virtual memories directly.
Infrastructure and tests enter the critical path only when they enable the active lived-person capability or protect a demonstrated invariant.
Encounter is the general lived primitive; meeting is one voluntary social form of encounter.
Co-presence does not automatically create Thread experience; a Thread may notice only part of an occurrence or nothing at all.
Objective Encounter Story, private Thread Experience, Journal, and autobiographical Memory are distinct authorities.
An objective Encounter Story may exist without Thread Experience; not_noticed occurrences must not leak into autobiographical recollection.
